title: Part 68 : 2023: Petroleum And Its Products - Methods Of Test For Part 68 Determination Of Evaporation Loss Of Lubricating Greases (22 Hour Drying)
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the method of test to determine the loss in mass by evaporation of lubricating greases under prescribed test conditions.
clause_3_terminology: Methods Of Test For Part 68 Determination Of Evaporation Loss Of Lubricating Greases

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
